title: Statistical analysis code for hospitalization and functional trajectories in CHARLS and HRS
description: Reproducible Python code for harmonized event-study analyses of activities of daily living and instrumental activities of daily living around first observed hospitalization in CHARLS and HRS. Participant-level data, manuscripts, tables, and generated figures are not included.
